caption: Railway bridge, Eglisau

description: The Eglisau railway bridge crosses high above the Rhine on limestone arches and a central steel truss, with the painted town and church below the deck. The covered wooden bridge that once stood here was removed in 1919 and is not put back. This replaces the Fraumünster riverside, already published. The Open-Meteo model is mainly clear and cool, about 13°C, with cloud cover a little under three-tenths, a breeze, humid air, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
